data.name: Ember in the Frost
data.detailed_description:
Game type:

The first and third person's 3D open doomsday multiplayer online survival construction.

Background:

In 2045, a sudden global freeze swept the world without warning. Ice and snow swallowed up all continents, the food chain completely collapsed, and social order disappeared. In the abyss of despair, the horror more terrible than the cold wakes up quietly-a zombie plague that evolved and spread because of cannibalism.

You are one of the few survivors hiding in wooden houses in remote suburbs. Outside, there are endless snowstorms and bloodthirsty infected people wandering on the ice sheet. They used to be hungry refugees, but now they have become irrational monsters who only know how to kill. Destroying the brain is the only way to stop them.

Atmosphere:

After a day's exploration, you come back, the cold wind whistling outside, and zombies growl inhumanely in the snow. You pull the latch and completely isolate cold, hunger and death.

The bonfire lit and the firewood crackled. The chill was forced back by a little bit from the cracks in the bones. You are drinking steaming coffee, the smell of canned pork that is still heating on the stove is spreading, and the dog "Grey Shadow" rescued from the mouth of the corpse a few days ago is resting its head on your boots. You gave it half a piece of meat, and it wagged its tail gently.

You inserted the new tape you found yesterday into the tape recorder, and an old song "The Sound of Silence" almost forgotten by the times flowed out. You lean against the corner, wiping the rifle you found from the zombie today, and thinking: there are seventeen bullets left, the medical kit will last for three days, and the firewood will last another night. On the windowsill, the tomato seed found in the ruins has sprouted green buds the size of a fingernail.

In this silent white hell, warmth is a luxury, loneliness is the norm, and tomorrow-forever more unknown than a snowstorm. Light a bonfire and hold the gun handle tightly. Your war begins with survival and ends at dawn.

Core experience:

The first three-person immersion survival

Trekking in the endless ice sheet from a realistic first and third person perspective. Feel the biting cold wind, gradually decreasing body temperature and real-time changing weather, and you need to go all out to survive every second.

Struggle for survival in the dynamic end of ice and snow

Manage body temperature, hunger, thirst and fatigue. Find shelter in the snowstorm and collect every piece of broken cloth, every piece of wood and every can of expired food. Plan your supplies carefully, because the next supply may be in the foreseeable future.

Resource collection and production

Multi-resource acquisition: cutting down frozen trees, breaking ice and fishing, digging veins, hunting, and searching for the remaining materials in abandoned towns.

Deep manufacturing system: combine resources to make weapons, winter clothes, tools, medical supplies, farming equipment and even power generation devices.

Agriculture and animal husbandry

Greenhouse planting: cultivate cold-resistant potatoes and greenhouse vegetables indoors to maintain long-term food sources.

Animal domestication: capture and raise snow dogs and reindeer as partners or resources, and dogs can be trained as zombie early warning assistants.

Against the environment and distorted infected people

Infected people adapt to the cold, and they will lurk in the snowfield and wander in the ruins. Use stealth to evade, or use the environment to make traps and weapons to confront. Remember: Gunfire may attract more uninvited guests, and your bullets are numbered.

Build and strengthen your last refuge.

Your little wooden house is the last beacon of civilization. Gradually strengthen the walls, set up alarms, build workstations, upgrade tools, and open up a precious greenhouse area to try to grow food. Turn it from a hiding place into a sustainable survival fortress.

Explore the frozen ruins in depth

Adventure into the cities buried by ice and snow, abandoned research institutes and shelters, looking for precious blueprints of science and technology, rare resources and clues behind disasters. Every expedition is a high-risk and high-return gamble.

data.short_description: This is a one-or three-person online survival game for the end of the world. The contents of the game include but are not limited to: pets, horseback riding, fishing, hunting, building, making, searching, killing zombies, bonfires, cooking, planting, mining, vehicles, furniture and firearms.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
